Troubleshooting · 30/50 · color

Gamma shift after export

Failure signal

A gamma shift after export condition is reported or detected during color.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for color does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Compare managed reference frames through the exact export and playback chain.

Corrective action

Align transfer metadata and transforms, then verify pixels and display behavior separately.

Prevention

Add this verification to the color gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
